headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 3, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing an 8-0 victory. Wenceel Pérez led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs. The Baltimore Orioles secured a 4-2 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Shane Baz earning the win after 7.0 innings of work. Rico Garcia closed out the game with a save. The Miami Marlins secured a 7-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Heriberto Hernández leading the charge at the plate, hitting two home runs and driving in three runs.

Several key players have been affected by injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Jonathan Heasley, a right-hander for the Tampa Bay Rays, has been placed on the 15-day injured list, retroactive to May 29, 2026. Braden Shewmake, a shortstop for the Houston Astros, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right adductor strain. Carlos Correa, also of the Astros, has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a left ankle tendon injury.

The Minnesota Twins have acquired right-handed pitcher Justin Lawrence in a trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates, who received cash in return. The Detroit Tigers traded right-hander Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for left-hander Juanmi Vasquez. The Colorado Rockies traded left-hander Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash.
